newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunker prices all gain, except Rotterdam.
newsitem.headline: European bunker prices all gain, except Rotterdam.

text.p: European bunker prices all firmed on Thursday except in ARA where prices were steady after two days of gains, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at around $91/$92 fob as barges again traded at around $90.
Total ARA trading volume was reasonable, at over 10,000, although two large enquiries accounted for much of the volume.
Hamburg prices increased in response to Wednesday's Rotterdam rise and healthier local demand.
Mediterranean prices mostly firmed by $1/$1.50 a tonne after increases in benchmark cargo prices.
Demand increased in most locations, notably in Spain, parts of which are on holiday on Friday.
"The Gibraltar area is completely congested and there are only clear schedules to lift from August," one supplier said.
